senses.title: A solid passing into a liquid
senses.definition: the process by which a solid mixes into a liquid until no separate solid remains
senses.definitionCN: 固体混入液体、直到不再有单独固体留下的过程
senses.example: Dissolution of the tablet is slower in cold tea.
senses.exampleCN: 药片在冷茶里溶解得更慢。
senses.why: The noun is the action form of the verb, and the verb's core picture is a structure being loosened until it no longer holds its shape.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词是动词的动作形式，而动词的核心图景是一个结构被松开到不再保持形状。

senses.title: The state of being dissolved
senses.definition: the condition of a substance that has become part of a solution rather than remaining separate
senses.definitionCN: 某物质已成为溶液一部分、不再单独存在的状态
senses.example: The report measured the dissolution of the minerals in the groundwater.
senses.exampleCN: 报告测定了矿物在地下水中的溶解状况。
senses.why: The same event can be viewed as a finished condition, so the noun also names the resulting state rather than the happening.
senses.whyCN: 同一件事也可以被看作完成后的状况，因此这个名词也命名结果状态，而非发生过程。

senses.title: An assembly formally ended
senses.definition: the formal ending of a parliament, council or company, after which it no longer meets or trades
senses.definitionCN: 议会、委员会或公司的正式终止，此后不再开会或营业
senses.example: The dissolution of parliament forced an early election.
senses.exampleCN: 议会解散迫使提前举行选举。
senses.why: A body is held together by rules and ties, so its ending is pictured as those ties being loosened all at once.
senses.whyCN: 一个机构靠规则与联结维持，因此它的终止被想象成这些联结一次全部松开。

senses.title: A marriage or partnership ended
senses.titleCN: 婚姻或合伙关系被解除
senses.definition: the legal ending of a marriage or of a business partnership
senses.definitionCN: 婚姻或商业合伙关系在法律上的终止
senses.example: The lawyer filed for dissolution of the partnership.
senses.exampleCN: 律师申请解除合伙关系。
senses.why: Law borrows the loosening image for any binding relation, so a marriage ends with the same noun as a firm.
senses.whyCN: 法律把「松开」的图景用于任何有约束力的关系，于是婚姻与公司用同一个名词结束。

senses.title: An ordered whole coming apart
senses.definition: the gradual breakdown of an empire, an institution or a system of order
senses.definitionCN: 帝国、制度或秩序体系逐渐瓦解
senses.example: Historians describe the dissolution of the old order over two centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学家描述旧秩序在两个世纪间的崩解。
senses.why: Societies are held by many bonds, and their slow loss of shape is described with the same word as a solid losing its edges.
senses.whyCN: 社会靠许多联结维持，它缓慢失去形状的过程，就用与固体失去边缘相同的词来描述。

senses.title: Death as a final loosening
senses.definition: a literary or formal way of speaking of death as the body's coming apart
senses.definitionCN: 以身体解体来指死亡的文学或正式说法
senses.example: The old poem speaks of dissolution as a returning to the elements.
senses.exampleCN: 那首古诗把死亡说成回归元素。
senses.why: If life is a held-together form, its end can be named by the word for the loosening of that form.
senses.whyCN: 如果生命是一种被维持在一起的形式，它的终结就可以用「该形式被松开」的词来命名。

senses.title: A treaty or contract terminated
senses.definition: the formal ending of a treaty, contract or agreement so that its obligations stop
senses.definitionCN: 条约、契约或协议正式终止，其义务随之停止
senses.example: The dissolution of the treaty left the frontier open to dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 条约的终止使边界陷入争议。
senses.why: An agreement is a tie between parties, and untying it is the literal old sense of the root.
senses.whyCN: 协议是各方之间的一条纽带，把它解开正是这个词根最古老的直白含义。

senses.title: Rock slowly taken apart by water
senses.definition: the chemical removal of mineral material from rock by water, which can hollow out caves and sinkholes
senses.definitionCN: 水把矿物从岩石中化学性地带走，可掏出洞穴与落水洞
senses.example: The dissolution of limestone created the cave system.
senses.exampleCN: 石灰岩的溶蚀形成了这一洞穴系统。
senses.why: Geology applies the noun to stone over long spans, where a liquid slowly carries a solid away grain by grain.
senses.whyCN: 地质学把这个名词用在长时段的石头上，那里液体把固体一粒一粒慢慢带走。

intro.en: Dissolution came through Old French from Latin dissolutio, the noun of dissolvere 'to loosen apart'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: dissolution 经古法语来自拉丁 dissolutio，它是 dissolvere「拆散、松开」的名词形式。年代为约数。

items.en: Solvere meant 'to loosen, untie, release'; its older make-up is debated, and the se- plus luere account is a common reconstruction.
items.cn: solvere 意为「松开、解开、释放」；其更早的构成存在争论，一般认为由 se- 加 luere 构成，属常见重构。

items.en: Dissolutio named the act of breaking bonds apart, used of physical separation and of dissolving an arrangement.
items.cn: dissolutio 命名拆开联结的动作，既用于物理分离，也用于终止某项安排。

items.en: Old French brought the noun into English in the medieval period, at first for the ending of a bond or an assembly.
items.cn: 古法语在中世纪把这个名词带入英语，最初指纽带或集会的终止。

items.en: Alchemy and pharmacy applied the noun to solids taken up by liquids, and that became one of its two everyday meanings.
items.cn: 炼金术与制药把这个名词用于被液体接纳的固体，这成为它两个日常义项之一。

items.en: Law used it for the ending of parliaments, companies and marriages, while literature used it for the breakdown of orders and for death.
items.cn: 法律用它指议会、公司与婚姻的终止，文学则用它指秩序的崩解与死亡。

items.en: Reconstruction for one detail: the pre-Latin history of solvere is unsettled, and the older form sometimes cited for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 有一处属重构形式：solvere 在拉丁语之前的历史尚未定论，为它引用的更古老形式属于重构。

note.en: The first group shares the solvere root and differs by word class; the second group holds the plain-language names for coming apart.
note.cn: 第一组共享 solvere 词根而词类不同；第二组是「分离、解体」的日常说法。

entries.definition: To bring about the loosening; the noun names the event or the resulting state.
entries.definitionCN: 促成松开；名词命名事件或结果状态。

entries.definition: The liquid with something dissolved in it, or the answer to a problem; it is the product, not the ending.
entries.definitionCN: 溶有某物的液体，或问题的答案；它是产物，而非终止。

entries.definition: Describing a substance that can be dissolved; it states a capacity, not an event.
entries.definitionCN: 描述可被溶解的物质；它说明能力，而非事件。

entries.definition: From the same root, but it means to settle or decide, loosening a difficulty rather than ending an institution.
entries.definitionCN: 词根相同，但意为解决或决定，松开的是困难，而不是终止机构。

entries.definition: A failure of a system, machine or order; it states the failure without the image of loosened bonds.
entries.definitionCN: 系统、机器或秩序的失效；它直说失效，不带「松开联结」的图景。

entries.definition: The process of breaking into small pieces; it stresses the pieces rather than the loosening of ties.
entries.definitionCN: 碎成小块的过程；它强调碎块，而非联结的松开。

entries.definition: The act of bringing something to an end; it is neutral about how the thing comes apart.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物结束的行为；它对「如何解体」保持中立。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real terms and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实术语与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The noun pairs with the verb: what dissolve does, dissolution is.
normal.cn: 名词与动词配对：dissolve 所做之事，就是 dissolution。

normal.en: The family runs dissolve, dissolution, dissolved, dissolvable, solution, soluble.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 dissolve、dissolution、dissolved、dissolvable、solution、soluble。

normal.en: Fixed phrases cover politics and pharmacy: dissolution of parliament, dissolution test.
normal.cn: 固定搭配覆盖政治与制药：解散议会、溶出度测定。

normal.en: The root also gives solve and resolve, which loosen problems instead of institutions.
normal.cn: 同一词根还给出 solve 与 resolve，它们松开的是问题而非机构。

normal.en: Geology uses it for limestone turned into caves by groundwater.
normal.cn: 地质学用它指石灰岩被地下水掏成洞穴。

abstract.en: Picture a tablet at the bottom of a cup with only a faint cloud left of it.
abstract.cn: 想象杯底一枚药片，最后只剩一层淡淡的浑雾。

abstract.en: Picture a rope bridge whose planks come loose one by one until nothing spans the gap.
abstract.cn: 想象一座绳桥的木板一块块松脱，最后什么也跨不过去。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd leaving a hall through many doors at once.
abstract.cn: 想象人群同时从许多扇门离开大厅。

examples.en: The dissolution of the old company took three years.
examples.cn: 旧公司的解散花了三年。

examples.en: Ocean water speeds the dissolution of the soft rock.
examples.cn: 海水加快了软岩的溶解。

examples.en: The poem treats death as a quiet dissolution.
examples.cn: 这首诗把死亡看作一场安静的消散。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「dis（散）+ solution（溶液）」——散成溶液，就是溶解

root: 拉丁 dissolutio ← dissolvere「拆散、松开」= dis-（分开）+ solvere「松开」；solvere 更早构成属重构性解释。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one loosening: a solid melts away, a substance is held in solution, a parliament closes, a marriage ends, an order breaks down, a body dies, a treaty lapses, and stone is hollowed by water.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一种松开：固体化掉、某物处于溶解状态、议会闭幕、婚姻结束、秩序崩解、身体死亡、条约失效、石头被水掏空。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tablet at the bottom of a cup, its rim eaten away until only cloudy water is left.
core.cn: 核心意象：杯底一枚药片，边缘一圈圈被吃掉，最后只剩浑水。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL PAIR: the event of a solid mixing away, and the finished state of being part of a liquid.
branches.cn: 物质的一对：固体混入液体的过程，以及已成为液体一部分的完成状态。

branches.en: THE BODY POLITIC: an assembly stops meeting, and a binding partnership is legally untied.
branches.cn: 政治体：集会不再开会，有约束力的合伙关系被依法解开。

branches.en: THE PAPER TIE: a treaty or contract lapses, and its obligations simply stop.
branches.cn: 纸面上的纽带：条约或契约失效，义务就此停止。

branches.en: THE LONG ENDING: a whole order loses its shape over centuries, and a body returns to the elements.
branches.cn: 漫长的终结：整个秩序在数百年里失去形状，身体回归元素。

branches.en: THE STONE: groundwater carries limestone away until caves are left behind.
branches.cn: 石头：地下水把石灰岩带走，留下洞穴。

intro.en: Dissolution is the noun of a Latin verb of loosening, and the same root builds solution, solve and resolve.
intro.cn: dissolution 是一个表示松开的拉丁动词的名词形式，同一词根构成 solution、solve 与 resolve。

latinIntro.en: Latin solvere and dissolvere give solution, dissolve, resolve and absolve, while dis- also appears in divide and disperse.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 solvere 与 dissolvere 衍生 solution、dissolve、resolve 与 absolve，而 dis- 也出现在 divide 与 disperse 中。

items.example: The prefix pushes the parts away from one another.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把各部分推开。

items.example: The root supplies the loosening.
items.exampleCN: 词根提供松开的动作。

items.example: The ending turns the verb into the name of an event.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把动词变成事件的名称。

items.structure: dis- plus solvere plus the action noun ending
items.meaning: the act or result of loosening apart
items.example: The dissolution of the tablet took a minute.
items.exampleCN: 药片溶解花了一分钟。

items.example: The sugar will dissolve in the tea.
items.exampleCN: 糖会在茶里溶开。

items.structure: solvere plus the action noun ending
items.example: The solution was left overnight.
items.exampleCN: 溶液放置了一夜。

items.structure: solvere plus the 'able to be' ending
items.example: The salt is highly soluble.
items.exampleCN: 这种盐极易溶解。

items.example: Water is the solvent in this reaction.
items.exampleCN: 在这个反应里水是溶剂。

items.structure: dissolve plus the 'able to be' ending
items.example: The capsule is dissolvable.
items.exampleCN: 这种胶囊可溶解。

latinEntries.structure: solvere, solvo, solvi, solutum (v., third conjugation)

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「溶解；解散」
由 dissolve 加已然词尾构成，义为「已溶解的」
由 dissolve 加「能够被……的」后缀构成，义为「可溶的」
